text: For a year or so I had a kind of existential dread. On sunny days especially, the sky would look thin and I'd feel that darkness behind it. I couldn't lie on my back in the grass. I had panic attacks a few times, always outdoors. Over time, I came to see it as an encounter with my own mortality and smallness, and it has made me less arrogant.

Ich hatte lange Albträume, in denen sie aus dem Fenster fällt. Ich konnte nicht mehr in der Nähe von offenen Fenstern in höheren Stockwerken sein. Unsere Freundschaft hat gelitten, weil wir beide nicht wussten, wie wir darüber reden sollen.
A strange sadness for a few weeks, then nothing.

Seit dieser Zeremonie habe ich das Gefühl, dass etwas in mir ist, das nicht zu mir gehört. Ich weiß rational, dass das nicht so ist, aber das Gefühl ist da, vor allem nachts. Ich habe oft Herzrasen und Engegefühle in der Brust. Ich hatte mehrere Panikattacken, bei denen ich dachte, der Schatten übernimmt mich wieder. Ich bin aus der Gruppe ausgetreten. Das war schwer, weil die Gruppe jahrelang mein soziales Umfeld war. Seitdem fühle ich mich sehr einsam und habe depressive Phasen. Ich habe auch Schwierigkeiten zu schlafen, weil ich Angst vor dem Moment des Einschlafens habe.

My depression got much worse after that night. The voice from the trip stayed. It's still there sometimes, saying the same things. I had suicidal thoughts on and off for months, more than before. I avoided mirrors. The scar on my hand reminds me every day. I also felt ashamed that I'd tried to fix my depression with drugs and made it worse.
Felt silly about it later. Jumpy in forests at night for a bit.
Ein paar Tage war ich sehr aufgewühlt. Danach hatte ich eher das Gefühl, etwas Wichtiges über mich und meine Angst vor Kontrollverlust gelernt zu haben.

I had nightmares about the lake and about his face, which was completely blank, for many months. I couldn't be the 'responsible one' in any situation without anxiety. I distanced myself from that friend group. I also had a lot of anger, which I'd never had before, and some hypervigilance in crowds.
Nichts Schlimmes, ich war nur ein paar Tage peinlich berührt.

I couldn't shake the feeling from the womb. For months I felt unwanted, by my mother, by my husband, by the world. I became depressed and very tired. At the same time, I became anxious about my kids, constantly watching them for signs that they felt unloved. I overcompensated, hugging them too much, saying I love you constantly, which my teenager found weird. I also became very angry at my mother, which I couldn't explain to her. Christmas that year was very difficult.

In the long run, though, it opened something that needed to be opened. I'd never questioned why I'm so exhausted all the time. I think I understand myself better now.
Felt a bit nihilistic for a while. Laughing in general made me uneasy. It passed.
Ich hatte danach Schuldgefühle und Angst um meine Freundin, die inzwischen gut eingestellt ist. Festivals meide ich. Ein paar Monate hatte ich Albträume von dem Sanitätszelt.
